title: (RHEA-2015:1580) New cartridges: JBoss Fuse, JBoss A-MQ, Fuse Builder
portal_summary:
The JBoss Fuse 6.2, JBoss A-MQ 6.2, and Fuse Builder cartridges are now
available for OpenShift Enterprise 2.2.0.
portal_synopsis: New cartridges: JBoss Fuse, JBoss A-MQ, Fuse Builder
portal_product_filter: Red Hat OpenShift Enterprise JBoss A-MQ add-on|Red Hat OpenShift Enterprise JBoss A-MQ add-on|2.2|x86_64
Red Hat OpenShift Enterprise JBoss FUSE add-on|Red Hat OpenShift Enterprise JBoss FUSE add-on|2.2|x86_64
portal_solution:
Before applying this update, make sure all previously released errata relevant
to your system have been applied.

See the release notes of the cartridge that you want to install for a list of
known issues:

JBoss Fuse 6.2
https://access.redhat.com/documentation/en-US/Red_Hat_JBoss_Fuse/6.2/html/Release_Notes/index.html

JBoss A-MQ 6.2
https://access.redhat.com/documentation/en-US/Red_Hat_JBoss_A-MQ/6.2/html/Release_Notes/index.html

See the OpenShift Enterprise 2.2 Release Notes for important instructions on how
to fully apply this asynchronous errata update:
https://access.redhat.com/documentation/en-US/OpenShift_Enterprise/2/html-single/2.2_Release_Notes/index.html#chap-Asynchronous_Errata_Updates

This update is available via the Red Hat Network. Details on how to use the Red
Hat Network to apply this update are available at
https://access.redhat.com/articles/11258.
portal_description:
These cartridges provide support to deploy JBoss Fuse 6.2 and JBoss A-MQ 6.2 in
an OpenShift Enterprise domain.

OpenShift Enterprise by Red Hat is the company's cloud computing
Platform-as-a-Service (PaaS) solution designed for on-premise or private cloud
deployments.

Red Hat JBoss Fuse and Red Hat JBoss A-MQ are small-footprint, open source
messaging platforms that provide real-time communication between applications,
devices, distributor outlets, and partners.

Please note that migration of applications is not possible between version 6.1
and 6.2 of the cartridges. Users who want to migrate need to re-create their
applications on the 6.2 cartridges. 

For information on how to get started, including important installation,
migration, and configuration steps, see the following documents:

JBoss Fuse 6.2
https://access.redhat.com/documentation/en-US/Red_Hat_JBoss_Fuse/6.2/html/Cloud_Deployment_Guide/index.html
https://access.redhat.com/documentation/en-US/Red_Hat_JBoss_Fuse/6.2/html/Migration_Guide/index.html

JBoss A-MQ 6.2
https://access.redhat.com/documentation/en-US/Red_Hat_JBoss_A-MQ/6.2/html/Cloud_Deployment_Guide/index.html
https://access.redhat.com/documentation/en-US/Red_Hat_JBoss_A-MQ/6.2/html/Migration_Guide/index.html
